children: Burberry is executing well, but the industry context remains difficult, RBC Capital Markets' Piral Dadhania and Richard Chamberlain say. The British luxury company has an improved strategy as well as better product assortment, adjusted prices and better merchandising for key categories such as scarves, the analysts write in a research note. However, this strategy relies largely on volumes, which seem to be under incremental pressure given that the luxury-demand environment remains lackluster, they add. RBC downgrades the stock to a sector perform rating from outperform. Shares closed at 1,026 pence on Monday. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
